image.name: onlyoffice
image.description: [ONLYOFFICE](https://www.onlyoffice.com/) provides a full range of tools to create, edit and collaborate on text documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF forms and regular PDF files on web, desktop and mobile platforms.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and documents

ports.desc: ONLYOFFICE desktop gui, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for ONLYOFFICE to function properly.

image.title: Onlyoffice
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  onlyoffice:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/onlyoffice:latest
    container_name: onlyoffice
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=onlyoffice \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/onlyoffice:latest
